title: Why Do Supercar Parts Cost More Than Your Car?
description:
A set of tyres for a Bugatti Veyron has been reported to cost more than many new cars. An oil change, around twenty thousand dollars. One supercar has its engine bay lined with real gold. Another needs its engine rebuilt like a Formula One car. It sounds like pure luxury. But almost every crazy price has an engineering reason behind it. Today, ten supercar parts that cost more than your car, and why each one exists.

Machine Reverse takes apart the machines you see every day and explains, part by part, why each one exists. This video covers 10 parts.

0:00 Intro
1:24 1. The Veyron tyres
2:51 2. The oil change
4:14 3. The gold engine bay
5:37 4. The hollow carbon wheels
7:00 5. The titanium bolts
8:23 6. The signed engine
9:46 7. The Formula One engine
11:10 8. The speed key
12:28 9. The titanium exhaust
13:45 10. The laser headlights
15:03 The verdict
